title: Hyperposition H2 Three-Topology Scoped Delta Runtime
summary: H2 refines H1 by separating semantic dependency topology, invariant/coordination topology and physical locality topology. Change polarity is represented by signed/typed deltas; coordination is selected from invariant interference; external effect authority remains independent. Synthetic tests support scoped closure when scopes are sound, demonstrate a rebuild crossover for wide revocation, and show relation-instance identity preserves n-ary semantics that pairwise flattening loses.
open_questions: Can real FRANK invariant scopes be inferred soundly enough for selective closure?
Where is the real incremental-versus-rebuild crossover for FRANK projections?
Do equal semantics round-trip across temporal log, reified graph and native hypergraph backends?
Can physical topology remapping reduce coherence/queue costs without semantic drift?
